In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-7 tetrahedral honeycomb''' is a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) with [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,3,7}. It has seven [[tetrahedra]] {3,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many tetrahedra existing around each vertex in an [[order-7 triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

== Related polytopes and honeycombs ==

It is a part of a sequence of [[regular polychora]] and honeycombs with [[tetrahedron|tetrahedral]] [[cell (geometry)|cells]], {3,3,''p''}.
{{Tetrahedral cell tessellations}}

It is a part of a sequence of hyperbolic honeycombs with [[order-7 triangular tiling]] [[vertex figure]]s, {''p'',3,7}.

In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''order-8 tetrahedral honeycomb''' is a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) with [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,3,8}. It has eight [[tetrahedra]] {3,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many tetrahedra existing around each vertex in an [[order-8 triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

{| class=wikitable width=480
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 3-3-8 poincare cc.png|240px]]<BR>[[Poincaré disk model]] (cell-centered)
<!--|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 3-3-8 poincare.png|240px]]<BR>Poincaré disk model-->
|[[File:H3 338 UHS plane at infinity.png|240px]]<BR>Rendered intersection of honeycomb with the ideal plane in [[Poincaré half-space model]]
|}

It has a second construction as a uniform honeycomb, [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,(3,4,3)}, Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|3|node|split1|branch|label4}}, with alternating types or colors of tetrahedral cells. In [[Coxeter notation]] the half symmetry is [3,3,8,1<sup>+</sup>] = [3,((3,4,3))].

{{Clear}}

In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''infinite-order tetrahedral honeycomb''' is a regular space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]) with [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,3,∞}. It has infinitely many [[tetrahedra]] {3,3} around each edge. All vertices are ultra-ideal (existing beyond the ideal boundary) with infinitely many tetrahedra existing around each vertex in an [[infinite-order triangular tiling]] [[vertex arrangement]].

{| class=wikitable width=480
|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 3-3-i poincare cc.png|240px]]<BR>[[Poincaré disk model]] (cell-centered)
<!--|[[File:Hyperbolic honeycomb 3-3-i poincare.png|240px]]<BR>Poincaré disk model-->
|[[File:H3 33i UHS plane at infinity.png|240px]]<BR>Rendered intersection of honeycomb with the ideal plane in [[Poincaré half-space model]]
|}

It has a second construction as a uniform honeycomb, [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,(3,∞,3)}, Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|3|node|3|node|infin|node_h0}} = {{CDD|node_1|3|node|split1|branch|labelinfin}}, with alternating types or colors of tetrahedral cells. In Coxeter notation the half symmetry is [3,3,∞,1<sup>+</sup>] = [3,((3,∞,3))].
